set.body: Run the final API-freeze gate: adversarial effect/domain identity tests; dense-oracle and algebraic laws; component-elision instrumentation; memory-plan search and RSS benchmarks; source lifecycle fault injection; receipt and cleanup truthfulness; conditional neuroim2 parity; the full test suite; source build; installed-tarball tests; R CMD check under a valid UTF-8 locale; and README/vignette execution against the installed artifact. Record qualified or blocked evidence explicitly; unit-test success alone does not close this item.
set.title: Certify semantic, resource, adapter, and installed-package behavior
